}}{{TIDTOC|embedded}} ==Overview== [https://chacon.com/datasharing/doc/IPCAM-RI01/ipcam-ri01_user_manual.pdf Product datasheet]
This camera is a rebranding of a manufacturing company identified by “PPStrong”. I’m sure there are other cameras out there that are using the same hardware (or similar with minor changes).
==Hardware details==
The camera mainboard is identified by “SPEED5S-H1MB_F23”.
The sensor is a JXF23.
==Original firmware==
The camera uBoot is password protected with “pps_password”.
